name: mta-p1-scoping
title: Malware traffic analysis, Part 1: scoping 6 IDS alerts

slides.title: 6 IDS alerts. One host behind all of them.
slides.sub: Before I chased a single domain, I checked what the alerts actually cover.

slides.title: What I started with
bullets: 02:13 to 02:16 UTC, six IPs, all on port 80

slides.title: All six alerted IPs talked to one client.
body: Filter on the six alert IPs, then Conversations with "Limit to display filter".
slides.caption: Every conversation involves 172.16.8[.]49.

slides.title: Then I removed that host from the filter.
slides.caption: Displayed: 0. No other internal host talked to the alerted IPs.

slides.title: What the scope looked like
bullets: Windows Update to `download.windowsupdate.com` checked and excluded as benign
The alerts showed 6 IPs. The capture had 15 domains with the same C2 pattern.

slides.title: Part 2: who is the user?
body: DHCP, Kerberos and SAMR. Each fact checked in a second protocol.
